measures.label: Process events
measures.definition: Count of validated privacy-minimised events in the reporting projection.

measures.label: Linked process objects
measures.definition: Count of distinct pseudonymous or source-local object references linked to validated events.

measures.label: Observed events
measures.definition: Count of events directly observed from an approved source and carrying confidence one.

measures.label: Inferred events
measures.definition: Count of events derived by an approved inference method and kept distinct from observed events.

measures.label: Completed-case events
measures.definition: Count of case_completed events. This is not assumed to equal unique completed cases until object semantics are validated.

measures.label: Committee deferrals
measures.definition: Count of committee_deferred events, reported with a controlled exception class where approved.

measures.label: Register reconciliation failures
measures.definition: Count of register_reconciliation_failed events. This does not itself establish an unauthorised practice event.

measures.label: Exception events
measures.definition: Count of validation_failed, committee_deferred and register_reconciliation_failed events.

measures.label: Rework events
measures.definition: Count of duplicate, validation, correction, deferral and reconciliation events used as an initial administrative-burden signal.

evidenceCeiling: These measures describe event-log behaviour. They do not establish clinical competence, policy compliance, unauthorised practice, causal benefit or operating effectiveness without source, denominator, workflow and human review evidence.
